promises.subheading: Four promises, on every plan — free or paid.

owned.title: You own what you share.
owned.body: Memory, profile, recommendations — all visible, exportable, deletable at any time.

noSell.title: We never sell your data.
noSell.body: Not to ad networks, not to data brokers, not to partners. Enforced in code.

earn.title: Your recommendations can earn for you.
earn.body: When your recommendation closes a sale through Sell and Earn, or when you host a paid Live Room, the income is yours — transparently disclosed.

control.title: You decide what Sell and Earn does for you.
control.body: Three switches in your Connect settings give you full control.

plans.needMoreTitle: Need more live time or hosting?
plans.needMoreBody: Premium covers most members. If you host community rooms or use voice every day, see our larger plans.
plans.trial14: Try free for 14 days. Cancel anytime.

faq.title: Why Premium?
faq.q1: What do I get with Premium?
faq.a1: More live voice time with ORB, more hosting in Live Rooms, more storage, and faster personal digests.
faq.a2: Credits are for occasional use. Premium gives you more of everything continuously — designed for daily use.
faq.a3: Yes, no contract. You keep Premium until the end of the current period.
faq.a4: Never. We never sell your data to ad networks, data brokers, or partners.
